name: 톱니 온실 제어실
prompt: Create a high-end cinematic environment artwork for an educational fantasy escape-room game. Landscape 3:2, AAA realistic 3D game environment / film production rendering, physically plausible lighting, richly detailed materials, atmospheric perspective. Inspired by a moonlit Scottish gothic castle: cool dark teal-blue night light with warm golden lantern light. NOT an illustration, NOT vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly. Beautiful and inviting for children without childish styling. No people, no creatures in the foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep the lower central foreground relatively open; interactive 3D props are placed in front later. Natural 40mm eye-level camera, horizon in the upper middle, subtle depth of field. SCENE: No people, no text, no UI, cinematic child-friendly greenhouse control room where ceiling cogs operate a glass roof vent, a large brass lever mounted on the stone wall ready to shift them; three-quarter composition, open lower-central foreground, warm amber control-light mixed with cool teal moonlight filtering through the glass panels, potted plants nearby, timber framework, layered mechanical-botanical depth, inventive fantasy concept art, faint droplets tracing the glass panes.
